'''''Dimorphotheca sinuata''''', the '''glandular Cape marigold''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=DISI4|taxon=Dimorphotheca sinuata|accessdate=18 January 2016}}</ref> '''Namaqualand daisy''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''orange Namaqualand daisy''';<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.museums.org.za/bio/plants/asteraceae/dimorphotheca.htm |title=''D. sinuata'' at Iziko Museums of Cape Town |access-date=2007-03-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070715211026/http://www.museums.org.za/bio/plants/asteraceae/dimorphotheca.htm |archive-date=2007-07-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref> [[syn.]] ''Dimorphotheca aurantiaca'' hort.<ref>{{GRIN | accessdate = 14 January 2018}}</ref>) is a species of plant native to southern [[Africa]]. It is also widely cultivated as an ornamental and naturalized in parts of the [[United States]], primarily [[California]] and [[Arizona]].<ref>[https://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Dimorphotheca%20sinuata.png Biota of North America Program 2014 county distribution map]</ref><ref>[https://www.calflora.org/cgi-bin/species_query.cgi?where-calrecnum=2733 Calflora taxon report, University of California, ''Dimorphotheca sinuata''  DC., African daisy,  Cape marigold, glandular cape marigold ]</ref>
[[File:Dimorphotheca_aurantiaca.png|left|thumb|upright]]
''Dimorphotheca sinuata'' grows in western [[South Africa]] and in [[Namibia]], very often in places receiving winter rainfall but also in sandy deserts.<ref>[http://www.plantzafrica.com/plantcd/dimorphsinuata.htm PlantZAfrica.com: ''Dimorphotheca sinuata'']</ref> It flowers early in spring. It is an annual sometimes exceeding 30 cm (12 inches) in height. [[Flower heads]] are generally yellow or orange with purple markings, containing both [[ray florets]] and [[disc floret]]s.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242412953 Flora of North America, ''Dimorphotheca sinuata'' de Candolle in A. P. de Candolle and A. L. P. P. de Candolle, Prodr. 6: 72. 1838. ]</ref><ref>Gibbs Russell, G. E., W. G. M. Welman, E. Retief, K. L. Immelman, G. Germishuizen, B. J. Pienaar, M. Van Wyk & A. Nicholas. 1987. List of species of southern African plants. Memoirs of the Botanical Survey of South Africa 2(1–2): 1–152(pt. 1), 1–270(pt. 2).</ref>
